report_review.assignment_compliance: Within the 1,300-1,700-word budget; six sources at the cap; includes one comparison table and one bounded prospective protocol. No Strata claim, threshold, precision recommendation, performance claim or implementation proposal.
report_review.scope_depth_review: Follows the R792 recommendation. Sampling units, pairing, task/context strata, multiple outcomes, seed variation, rare events and interim looks form a coherent evidence-design investigation; alternatives, assumptions and transfer limits are covered. Its 256-prompt/three-seed example has no power rationale and is explicitly not a qualification protocol.
report_review.novelty_and_redundancy: Distinct from R791's metric/localization discussion: R794 asks how to quantify sampling uncertainty and coverage after outcomes exist. Compared only the index and R792 review metadata; no older collection bodies were reopened.

primary_source_checks.checked: Official ACL record/PDF support general NLP test selection and note dependence among dataset points; not autoregressive-inference evidence.
Official ACL record/PDF confirm paired bootstrap on aligned sentence samples for BLEU; the report correctly limits transfer from machine translation.

Full paper confirms three seeds for in-context-example selection, a 1,000-instance sample and the warning that claims may be statistically insignificant; it also reports paired bootstrap for human evaluations. These are not decoding seeds.
Original article scan confirms Type I error protection for combinations of true hypotheses. DOI landing page unavailable; text checked at https://www.ime.usp.br/~abe/lista/pdf4R8xPVzCnX.pdf.
Project Euclid journal record confirms time-uniform bounds from nonnegative supermartingales and that assumptions are part of the result.

Original article text hosted by McGill confirms the approximate 0/n upper 95% bound of 3/n. DOI landing page unavailable; text checked at https://jhanley.biostat.mcgill.ca/c607/ch08/zero_numerator.pdf.

source_attribution.assessment: Bibliographic attributions and methodological roles were checked against primary papers or original article text. These sources do not establish Strata, Intel GPU/SYCL, model-specific BF16 quality, speed or maximum-context correctness. Copyright/license statements were not audited as legal conclusions; no text or code reuse is proposed.
source_attribution.correction: If retrieved to select a test, state that randomization-test validity requires a justified null exchangeability/randomization scheme; paired t inference requires independent prompt-level differences and suitable distributional or large-sample conditions. The report's example counts are not validated sample sizes.

report_review.provenance_limit: The methods are external evidence; the protocol is a synthesis, not a published or locally validated gate. No source reuse is proposed and no external result qualifies native16.

next_research_scopes.title: Pilot-based sample sizing for paired stochastic native16 quality studies
next_research_scopes.finite_question: After a fixed quality pilot supplies prompt-family IDs, per-prompt paired outcomes by precision arm, repeated-seed variation, task/context strata and the study owner's predeclared meaningful-change margin, compare defensible sample-size or interval-width planning methods for clustered prompts and nested seeds. Explain pilot-reuse limits and multiplicity costs. Do not set an acceptance threshold or infer a quality result.
next_research_scopes.breadth_and_counterevidence: Focus on quantitative design from measured pilot variance, including prompt-family dependence, within-prompt seeds and stratified allocation. Compare a few methods, assumptions, failure cases and costs. Do not repeat R794's generic paired-test, Holm, rare-event or time-uniform discussion; do not discuss kernels or precision mitigations.
next_research_scopes.report_budget: 1,300-1,700 words; at most six primary statistical sources; one comparison table and one bounded planning example using only the supplied pilot summary.
next_research_scopes.prerequisites: Wait until regression completes and Main supplies a qualified paired quality pilot with a frozen prompt frame, family IDs, per-prompt outcomes for both arms, repeat-seed summaries where stochastic decoding is in scope, and an owner-selected meaningful-change margin. Public sources alone are insufficient because planning requires measured variance.
prerequisite_evidence: Current index native16_activation_pipeline marks quality_acceptance=UNSET, performance_qualified=false and physical_context_qualified=false.
Main status supplied for this review says no native16 model-quality result exists and regression is still running.
R794 has no sample-size rationale and explicitly disclaims power qualification for its 256-prompt/three-seed illustration.
next_research_scopes.novelty_guard: Quantitative allocation and uncertainty planning from actual pilot variance only. Do not recommend a precision change, choose release tolerances or treat an illustrative cap as a qualification criterion.

operational_digest_ja_400_chars: R794は割当どおりの知識収集で、1,478語・6出典。範囲はR791の指標説明から標本不確実性設計へ進み、Mainの現時点の判断には原文不要。出典の方法論上の主張を原典照合し、Strataへの適用不可と再読条件を索引案に記録。次調査は品質pilot後に限り、今は開始不可。索引は未変更。
